summary: To come, and what is coming: 來者, those still to come; 如來, the Thus-Come.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Lorenz-84 trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 望 takes the highest point, gazing up; 劫 the point farthest from the rest, at the edge of the eon. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: What Is Coming Can Still Be Reached
satellites.evidence: Analects 18.5, the madman of Chu sings as he passes Confucius: 鳳兮鳳兮，何德之衰？往者不可諫，來者猶可追 — “phoenix, phoenix, how virtue has declined! What is gone cannot be argued with; what is coming can still be caught.”
